description: galpynostatic is a Python and C++ package for predicting fast-charging conditions for lithium-ion batteries. Its developer publishes physics-based and data-driven modules, tutorials and an API reference. Users supply electrode or cell parameters and charging conditions; the models estimate operating limits and charging behaviour for the tested battery configuration. The scale is a cell or electrode, not a mapped power network, and simulated time follows the charge experiment. MIT-licensed source is free on GitHub and PyPI. The README cites a 2023 article describing the heuristic galvanostatic model. A limitation is that cell-level predictions require material-specific calibration before they can be used to infer grid-scale storage or vehicle-fleet behaviour. The package can inform charging constraints in electric-vehicle and battery-storage infrastructure simulations. The catalogue's model-pandapower represents the network layer where such charging loads may be studied; no software connection was tested. No experimental dataset or example was run.
